name: CAR Direct Traffic Campaign Operations
family_scope: campaign lifecycle and performance policies supplied by each consumer
operation_parameters_required: account, Page, pixel, event and timezone

isolation.no_cross_inheritance: a consumer never inherits account IDs, budget, event, schedule, source or state from another domain

speed_invariants.page_assignment: authorized SHEIN/CAR Pages may be assigned in Business Manager and are still validated live before write
speed_invariants.media_upload: on demand only after the exact account is present in the campaign request; no upload to guessed or multiple accounts
speed_invariants.dual_variant: CAR keeps vertical+square when placement labels require both
speed_invariants.pipeline: three parallel per-asset lanes with deterministic titles, missing-variant-only upload and one batch-ready/association validation
speed_invariants.account_scaling: manifest builder is account-profile scoped; account 13 remains the backward-compatible default and account 05 uses b01fb05 without code patching
